name: Message
description: Represents an outbound or inbound communications message across any channel (SMS, MMS, voice, email, push, chat, in-app) delivered through a CPaaS, ESP, push, or realtime messaging provider.

id.description: Provider-assigned unique identifier for the message.

direction.description: Whether the message is being sent outbound or received inbound.

from.description: Sender address: phone number (E.164), email address, push token, or channel-specific identifier.

to.description: Recipient address: phone number (E.164), email address, push token, user id, or channel-specific identifier.

subject.description: Subject line, used primarily for email and chat threads.

body.example: Your verification code is 482913. It expires in 10 minutes.

html.description: HTML body of the message, used primarily for email.

template_id.description: Identifier of a server-side template used to render the message.

template_data.description: Variables passed into a server-side template.

media_urls.description: URLs of media attachments such as MMS images or push notification images.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the message was created.

sent_at.description: Timestamp when the message was handed off to the carrier or downstream channel.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata or tags attached to the message for analytics, A/B testing, or workflow correlation.
